1161: then the Lord comes to dwell within and fulfils the purpose of his life. ॥1॥
O mind, think over some such higher understanding.
ਹਰਿ. ਕੀ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ; ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Why do you not remember the Lord, the destroyer of all pain? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ; ਸਿੰਘੁ ਰਹੈ ਬਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
As long as the lion of pride lives in the forest of the heart,
ਤਬ ਲਗੁ; ਬਨੁ ਫੂਲੈ ਹੀ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
that garden of the heart does not come into flower.
ਜਬ ਹੀ ਸਿਆਰੁ; ਸਿੰਘ ਕਉ ਖਾਇ ॥
But when the jackal of humility eats the lion,
all the greenery of the heart bursts into bloom. ॥2॥
One who thinks he has won the game drowns; one who walks in humility swims,
and by his Guru's grace he crosses to the far shore.
The servant Kabir explains and says:
keep your mind joined to the Lord alone. ॥3॥6॥14॥
ਸਤਰਿ ਸੈਇ ਸਲਾਰ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
The God who, you tell me, has seven thousand angels,
and, you say, a hundred and twenty-five thousand prophets,
whose learned elder sheikhs are said to number eighty-eight crore,
ਛਪਨ ਕੋਟਿ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਖੇਲ ਖਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
and whose courtiers you put at fifty-six crore: ॥1॥
who will carry a poor man's plea to Him?
ਮਜਲਸਿ ਦੂਰਿ; ਮਹਲੁ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
His court is far away; who will find His dwelling for me? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Thirty-three crore gods are His servants,
and the beings of eighty-four lakh species wander about deranged.
ਬਾਬਾ ਆਦਮ ਕਉ; ਕਿਛੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥
When God showed Father Adam a slight frown,
even he enjoyed that paradise only a short while. ॥2॥
ਦਿਲ ਖਲਹਲੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਜਰਦ ਰੂ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
Whoever has turmoil in his heart, his face turns pale;
he leaves the way of his scriptures and walks the evil road,
he blames the world and is angry with people,
though he only receives what he himself has done. ॥3॥
You are my giver and I am for ever the beggar at Your door;
if I answered back at any gift of Yours, the sin would be mine.
I, Your servant Kabir, have come to Your shelter.
O Merciful One, keep me near You: that is paradise for me. ॥4॥7॥15॥
ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਚਲਨ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ; ਊਹਾਂ ॥
Everyone says he is bound for that heaven,
ਨਾ ਜਾਨਉ; ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ ਹੈ ਕਹਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
but I have not understood where their heaven is. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਆਪ ਆਪ ਕਾ ਮਰਮੁ; ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
They have not found the secret of their own selves,
and speak of heaven in mere talk. ॥1॥
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ; ਮਨ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥
O mind, as long as you hope to reach heaven,
you cannot dwell at the Lord's feet. ॥2॥
What moat, what city, what rampart their heaven has,
and what its gate is like, I do not know. ॥3॥
Says Kabir: whom can one now tell
that the company of the holy is itself heaven? ॥4॥8॥16॥
Brother, this strong fortress of the body is very hard to take;
ਦੋਵਰ ਕੋਟ ਅਰੁ ਤੇਵਰ ਖਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
round it run the double wall of duality and the triple moat of the three qualities. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪਾਂਚ ਪਚੀਸ, ਮੋਹ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ; ਆਡੀ. ਪਰਬਲ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Backed by mighty Maya stand the five passions, the twenty-five elements, attachment, pride and envy;
ਜਨ ਗਰੀਬ ਕੋ ਜੋਰੁ. ਨ ਪਹੁਚੈ; ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਰਘੁਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
I, a poor man, can do nothing against them; O Lord, what am I to do? ॥1॥
ਕਾਮੁ ਕਿਵਾਰੀ. ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਰਵਾਨੀ; ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ ॥
Lust is master of the door, pain and pleasure are the sentries, sin and merit are the gates,
ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨੁ. ਮਹਾ ਬਡ ਦੁੰਦਰ; ਤਹ. ਮਨੁ ਮਾਵਾਸੀ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੨॥
quarrelsome anger is the chief, and there the mind sits as a rebel king. ॥2॥
ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਸਨਾਹ. ਟੋਪੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਕੋ; ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਕਮਾਨ ਚਢਾਈ ॥
He wears the armour of relish and the helmet of possessiveness, and has strung the bow of bad counsel;
ਤਿਸਨਾ ਤੀਰ. ਰਹੇ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਇਉ ਗਢੁ ਲੀਓ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
the arrows of craving are drawn tight within; such a fortress cannot be taken. ॥3॥
ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਲੀਤਾ. ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹਵਾਈ; ਗੋਲਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
But I lit the fuse of love, made a rocket of my attention and fired the shell of wisdom;
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨਿ, ਸਹਜੇ ਪਰਜਾਲੀ; ਏਕਹਿ ਚੋਟ ਸਿਝਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
in stillness of mind I kindled the divine light within, and a single blow won the day. ॥4॥
ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਲੈ. ਲਰਨੇ ਲਾਗਾ; ਤੋਰੇ ਦੁਇ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ ॥
Taking virtue and contentment I began to fight and broke down both gates;
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ; ਪਕਰਿਓ ਗਢ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੫॥
by the grace of the true Guru and the company of the holy I seized the fortress's king. ॥5॥
1162: ਭਗਵਤ ਭੀਰਿ. ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੀ; ਕਟੀ ਕਾਲ ਭੈ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
By the strength of holy company and of remembrance I have cut the noose of death and of worldly fears.
ਦਾਸੁ ਕਮੀਰੁ. ਚੜੑਿਓ ਗੜੑ ਊਪਰਿ; ਰਾਜੁ ਲੀਓ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੬॥੯॥੧੭॥
The Lord's servant Kabir has climbed atop the fortress and taken a kingdom that never perishes. ॥6॥9॥17॥
Into the deep and solemn mother Ganges,
they took me, Kabir, bound in chains. ॥1॥
ਮਨੁ. ਨ ਡਿਗੈ; ਤਨੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਡਰਾਇ ॥
his mind does not waver, so there is no use in frightening his body,
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ; ਚਿਤੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the one whose mind stays absorbed in the Lord's lovely feet. ॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੰਗਾ ਕੀ ਲਹਰਿ; ਮੇਰੀ ਟੁਟੀ ਜੰਜੀਰ ॥
The waves of the Ganges broke my chains,
and I, Kabir, floated as if seated on a deerskin. ॥2॥
ਕਹਿ ਕੰਬੀਰ; ਕੋਊ. ਸੰਗ ਨ ਸਾਥ ॥
Says Kabir: none of your rites can be a companion or a friend;
on water and on land the Lord alone is able to protect. ॥3॥10॥18॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
A person makes his home in a fortress that the vices cannot reach or approach,
the one within whom the Lord sheds His light;
within him lightning seems to flash and there is constant bloom,
in the heart where the childlike Lord Gobind comes to dwell. ॥1॥
ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
When this soul fixes its attention on the Lord's Name,
ਜਰਾ ਮਰਨੁ ਛੂਟੈ; ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
its dread of old age and of death ends and its wandering goes. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਸਿਉ; ਮਨ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
But those whose minds are set on who is of low caste and who of high
are for ever talking the talk of pride.
There an unbroken music of the Lord's praise keeps sounding,
in the heart where the Lord Gopal dwells. ॥2॥
The Lord who fashions all the regions and spheres,
who is also the destroyer of the three worlds and the three qualities,
whom the senses cannot reach, dwells in that person's heart;
ਪਾਰੁ. ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋ; ਧਰਨੀਧਰ ਮੰਤ ॥੩॥
yet no one can find the end of the mystery of the Lord who upholds the earth. ॥3॥
As fragrance shows itself in the flowers of the plantain,
as pollen comes to rest in the lotus,
so the Lord's mantra settles in that fully blossomed heart,
the heart in which the Lord, husband of Maya, comes to dwell. ॥4॥
He sees the Lord's light everywhere, in sky and underworld;
in his thought-free, settled mind the Lord sheds His light,
a light that sun and moon cannot match;
the Lord, stainless source of all the world, stirs joy in his heart. ॥5॥
He recognises in the whole world the same Lord he sees in his own body,
and he bathes in the Mansarovar of the Name,
ਸੋਹੰ ਸੋ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਜਾਪ ॥
the one in whose heart is the constant sense that the Lord and I are one,
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਲਿਪਤ. ਨ ਹੋਇ; ਪੁੰਨ ਅਰੁ ਪਾਪ ॥੬॥
and on whom neither merit nor sin can take any hold. ॥6॥
No distinction of high or low caste remains in him, and neither pain nor pleasure touches him.
ਅਵਰ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਮ ॥
This state is found in the Guru's shelter and nowhere else;
ਟਾਰੀ. ਨ ਟਰੈ; ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
no one can dislodge it; it stays for ever.
He stays settled in the thought-free state, joined in stillness of mind. ॥7॥
One who recognises the Lord dwelling in his own mind,
and who praises Him, becomes the Lord's own likeness.
One who through the Guru's word fixes the Lord's light firmly in his mind,
says Kabir, that person swims across the world-ocean. ॥8॥1॥
I beg of the Lord at whose door millions of suns give light,
at whose door are millions of Shivas and Kailashes,
ਦੁਰਗਾ ਕੋਟਿ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਰਦਨੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
whose feet millions of Durgas massage,
and at whose door millions of Brahmas recite the Vedas. ॥1॥
Whenever I beg, I beg only at the Lord's door;
ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸਿਉ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I have no business with any other god. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
At whose door millions of moons give light,
1163: from whose door the thirty-three crore gods eat their food,
in whose court millions of sets of the nine planets stand,
and whose doorkeepers are millions of Dharmrajas. ॥2॥
Over whose upper storey millions of winds blow,
whose bed millions of Sheshnags spread,
whose water-carriers are millions of oceans,
and the hairs of whose body are, as it were, millions of times the eighteen loads of vegetation. ॥3॥
Whose treasuries millions of Kubers fill,
at whose door millions of Lakshmis adorn themselves,
to whom millions of sins and merits look for His command,
ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਕੋਟਿ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ॥੪॥
and at whose door millions of Indras serve. ॥4॥
At whose door fifty-six crore clouds are the doorkeepers,
at whose door millions of Kalikas stand, hair unbound and fearsome in form,
and at the door of that Gopal millions of powers are at play. ॥5॥
In whose court millions of sacrificial feasts are held,
and millions of Gandharvas sing His triumph,
whose endless virtues millions of branches of learning describe,
ਤਊ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ; ਅੰਤੁ. ਨ ਲਹੈ ॥੬॥
and still they cannot find the limit of the Supreme Lord's virtues. ॥6॥
The hairs of whose body are, as it were, millions of Vaman incarnations,
at whose door are millions of the Ram Chandra by whom Ravan's army was beaten,
at whose door are millions of the Krishna whom the Bhagavat Puran describes,
ਕੰਦ੍ਰਪ ਕੋਟਿ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਲਵੈ. ਨ ਧਰਹਿ ॥
Whose beauty millions of gods of love cannot equal,
they who are for ever stealing the desire deep within the hearts of beings.
Says Kabir: hear me, O Lord who bears the bow,
grant me the state in which I fear no one; this is the gift I beg. ॥8॥2॥18॥20॥
ਭੈਰਉ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
I would cut this tongue into a hundred pieces
if ever now it failed to utter the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
ਰੰਗੀ ਲੇ ਜਿਹਬਾ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
I have dyed my tongue in the Lord's Name;
ਸੁਰੰਗ ਰੰਗੀਲੇ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
by remembering the Lord again and again I have dyed it a lovely colour. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
A tongue busy with other tasks is worthless,
ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦੁ; ਇਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
for the Lord's Name alone brings the state free of desire. ॥2॥
Were I to offer countless millions of other worships,
all of them together would not equal the Lord's Name. ॥3॥
Namdev prays: this is the work fit for my tongue,
to say, O Narayan, Your forms are endless. ॥4॥1॥
One who has given up another's wealth and another's wife,
the Lord dwells close beside him. ॥1॥
Those who do not worship the Lord,
ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਮੈ; ਨ ਕਰਉ ਦਰਸਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I do not go to see them. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Those who have a distance from God within them
are people no different from beasts. ॥2॥
a man does not look handsome, though he has all thirty-two marks of beauty. ॥3॥2॥
Water in the jug and milk in the cup:
Nama has milked the pale cow and brought it. ॥1॥
Drink the milk, O radiant Gobind;
drink the milk, so that my mind is soothed;
ਨਾਹੀ ਤ; ਘਰ ਕੋ ਬਾਪੁ ਰਿਸਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
if You do not, my soul will be grieved. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The pure cup of the heart, filled with the nectar of the Name,
Nama has taken and set before his Lord. ॥2॥
My single-minded devotee dwells always in My heart,
says the Lord, glad as He looks upon Nama. ॥3॥
Having given Him the milk to drink, the devotee settled in his own true self,
1164: and there I, Nama, had the sight of the Lord. ॥4॥3॥
The Lord is my husband and I have gone mad for Him;
ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ; ਕਰਉ ਸਿੰਗਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
to meet Him I deck myself in lovely adornments. ॥1॥
ਭਲੇ ਨਿੰਦਉ. ਭਲੇ ਨਿੰਦਉ; ਭਲੇ ਨਿੰਦਉ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
Let people call me bad, let them, let them as much as they like;
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ; ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
my body and my mind are now given over to my beloved Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਾਦੁ ਬਿਬਾਦੁ; ਕਾਹੂ ਸਿਉ. ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
There is no need to quarrel with anyone;
with the tongue one should drink the fine nectar of the Lord's Name. ॥2॥
ਅਬ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਨਿ; ਐਸੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
Now that I have come to know the Lord in my heart, such a state has arisen
that I am meeting my Lord heedless of what people say against me. ॥3॥
Whether someone speaks well of me or ill,
I, Nama, have met the Lord, husband of Lakshmi. ॥4॥4॥
ਕਬਹੂ; ਖੀਰਿ ਖਾਡ ਘੀਉ. ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
At times a person does not care even for rice pudding, sugar and ghee;
at times He has him beg scraps from house to house;
at times He has him rake through rubbish heaps and pick out grains. ॥1॥
ਜਿਉ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਖੈ; ਤਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Brother, we should live in whatever state the Lord keeps us;
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ; ਕਿਛੁ ਕਥਨੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
how great the Lord is cannot be told at all. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
At times a man has fine horses prancing;
at times he cannot find even a shoe for his foot. ॥2॥
At times He lays a man to sleep on a bed with white sheets;
at times he does not get even straw to spread on the ground. ॥3॥
Says Namdev: the one Name alone carries a person across;
ਜਿਹ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਿਹ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੫॥
whoever meets the Guru, the Lord takes him across. ॥4॥5॥
Full of eagerness I came to Your temple,
but as I, Nama, was at worship they seized me and turned me out. ॥1॥
People call my caste low, O Lord, chief of the Yadavs;
ਛੀਪੇ ਕੇ ਜਨਮਿ; ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
why was I born into a calico-printer's house? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I picked up my blanket and turned back,
and went and sat down behind the temple. ॥2॥
ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਨਾਮਾ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
As Nama goes on singing the Lord's praises,
the temple keeps turning round for the sake of His devotees. ॥3॥6॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
As food is dear to a hungry man,
as a thirsty man has need of water,
as a fool comes to lean on his family,
so does Nama love the Lord. ॥1॥
Nama's love has fastened on the Lord,
and without taking up any outward garb he has become a renunciate. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
As a woman gives her love to another man,
as a greedy man holds wealth dear,
as a lustful man is fond of a woman,
so is the Lord sweet to Nama. ॥2॥
But the real love is the one the Lord Himself kindles;
by the Guru's grace that person's sense of mine and yours goes;
his love never breaks, and he stays joined to the Lord's feet.
Nama's mind has settled in the Lord's everlasting Name. ॥3॥
As is the love between mother and child,
so is my mind dyed in the Lord.
Namdev prays: my love is fastened on the Lord,
and He now dwells in my mind. ॥4॥1॥7॥
The blind sinner abandons his own wife
1165: and wastes himself on another's woman,
glad as the parrot is glad at the sight of the simmal tree;
in the end he dies still caught in this vice. ॥1॥
The sinner's dwelling is always in that fire
ਜਲਤ ਰਹੈ; ਮਿਟਵੈ ਕਬ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
which keeps burning and is never put out. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ; ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
He does not go to see the place where the Lord is worshipped;
leaving the straight road he takes the wrong one;
straying from the Lord, the source, he falls into the round of birth and death;
he spills the nectar of the Name, loads up poison and eats it. ॥2॥
As when prostitutes hold their performances,
put on fine dress and adorn themselves,
the prostitute dances and carefully weighs her pitch,
ਵਾ ਕੇ ਗਲੇ; ਜਮ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਫਾਸ ॥੩॥
and the noose of death falls about her neck. ॥3॥
One on whose forehead the Lord's grace is written
ਸੋ ਭਜਿ; ਪਰਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
turns away from vice and takes the Guru's shelter.
O saints, only in this way, in the Guru's shelter, will you cross over. ॥4॥2॥8॥
ਸੰਡਾ ਮਰਕਾ ਜਾਇ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ॥ ਪੜੈ ਨਹੀ; ਹਮ ਹੀ ਪਚਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
Sanda and Amarka went and complained: we are worn out, he will not study;
ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹੈ. ਕਰ ਤਾਲ ਬਜਾਵੈ; ਚਟੀਆ ਸਭੈ ਬਿਗਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
he claps his hands in rhythm and sings the Lord's Name, and has spoiled all the other pupils. ॥1॥
He repeats the Lord's Name all the time,
ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਧਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and keeps the remembrance of the Lord held in his heart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਸੁਧਾ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਭ ਰਾਜੇ; ਬਿਨਤੀ ਕਰੈ ਪਟਰਾਨੀ ॥
The chief queen pleads with him: the king has brought the whole earth under his rule;
ਪੂਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਕਹਿਆ. ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੈ; ਤਿਨਿ ਤਉ ਅਉਰੈ ਠਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
but her son Prahlad does not heed her; he has set his mind on something else. ॥2॥
ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਾ ਮਿਲਿ, ਮੰਤਰ ਉਪਾਇਆ; ਕਰਸਹ ਅਉਧ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥
The band of villains met and resolved: we will put an end to him;
ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰ. ਜਲ ਜੁਆਲਾ ਭੈ ਰਾਖਿਓ; ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
but the Lord, the King, turned the nature of His Maya and saved him from the terror of mountain, tree, water and fire. ॥3॥
ਕਾਢਿ ਖੜਗੁ. ਕਾਲੁ ਭੈ ਕੋਪਿਓ; ਮੋਹਿ ਬਤਾਉ. ਜੁ ਤੁਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
Afraid within yet raging, he drew his sword of death: show me who can save you.
ਪੀਤ ਪੀਤਾਂਬਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਧਣੀ; ਥੰਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਖੈ ॥੪॥
The Lord in yellow robes, master of the three worlds, speaks from within the pillar. ॥4॥
ਹਰਨਾਖਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਖਹ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਓ; ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਕੀਏ ਸਨਾਥਾ ॥
The Lord who tore Harnakhash apart with His nails and gave heart to gods and men,
ਕਹਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ. ਹਮ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹ ਰਾਮੁ; ਅਭੈ ਪਦ ਦਾਤਾ ॥੫॥੩॥੯॥
says Namdev, Him I too remember; the Lord alone gives the state of fearlessness. ॥5॥3॥9॥
I want to see the works of your Ram. ॥1॥
The Sultan had me, Nama, bound:
I want to see your Lord, your Bithal. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Bring this dead cow back to life,
or I will kill you too, here and now. ॥2॥
O King, how can such a thing be?
No one who has died has ever lived again. ॥3॥
Nothing comes about by my doing;
ਕਰਿ ਹੈ ਰਾਮੁ; ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
only what the Lord does comes to pass. ॥4॥
and goaded a great elephant upon me. ॥5॥
ਛੋਡਿ ਰਾਮੁ; ਕੀ ਨ. ਭਜਹਿ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥੬॥
why do you not give up Ram and say Khuda? ॥6॥
ਨ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਪੂੰਗੜਾ; ਨ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
I am not your son and you are not my mother;
ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪੜੈ; ਤਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੭॥
even if my body perishes, Nama will go on singing the Lord's praises. ॥7॥
The elephant strikes with its trunk,
but Nama escapes, for he has the Lord's support. ॥8॥
The qazis and mullahs salute me,
but this Hindu has broken my pride. ॥9॥
1166: Take gold weighed equal to Namdev and let him go. ॥10॥
He answered: if I take a bribe, I fall into hell,
for so I would leave my faith and gather wealth. ॥11॥
Namdev's feet are in fetters, yet he beats time with his hands,
and Namdev sings the praises of God. ॥12॥
Even if the Ganges and the Jamuna begin to flow backwards,
Namdev will still go on singing the Lord's praises. ॥13॥
When seven gharis were heard to have gone by,
I thought: the Master of the three worlds has still not come. ॥14॥
Then came the sound of beating wings,
and Vishnu came, riding on Garuda. ॥15॥
the Lord came riding on Garuda. ॥16॥
He said: if you ask, I will tilt the earth;
ਕਹਹਿ ਤ; ਲੇ ਕਰਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਧਰਉ ॥੧੭॥
if you ask, I will take hold of it and turn it upside down. ॥17॥
ਕਹਹਿ ਤ; ਮੁਈ ਗਊ ਦੇਉ ਜੀਆਇ ॥
If you ask, I will bring the dead cow back to life,
so that everyone here may see it and be satisfied. ॥18॥
I, Namdev, asked the people to hobble the cow for milking,
and they let the calf loose and milked the cow. ॥19॥
When they had drawn the milk and filled the pot,
they took it and set it before the king. ॥20॥
The king went into his palace,
and there a hard hour came upon him. ॥21॥
Through his qazis and mullahs he sent a plea:
Command me, O Hindu, and forgive me; I am your cow. ॥22॥
The measure of this pledge will be
that from now on, O king, you walk in truth and keep a good nature. ॥24॥
Namdev came to be talked of in every home,
ਮਿਲਿ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਸਭ; ਨਾਮੇ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨੫॥
and all the Hindus of the town came together to Namdev, saying: ॥25॥
ਜਉ ਅਬ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ; ਨ ਜੀਵੈ ਗਾਇ ॥
had the cow not come to life this time,
Namdev's credit would have been lost. ॥26॥
Namdev's renown remains in the world,
and the Lord has taken His devotees and servants to His feet and carried them across. ॥27॥
Hearing of it, the slanderers suffered great anguish and pain,
for they do not know that no distance remains between Namdev and God. ॥28॥1॥10॥
If the Guru is met, God is met;
if the Guru is met, a person crosses the world-ocean;
if the Guru is met, he crosses over and reaches Vaikunth;
if the Guru is met, his mind stays dead to vices while he lives in the world. ॥1॥
ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ; ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
Know for certain that serving the Guru alone is the effort that lasts for ever;
ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ; ਆਨ ਸਭ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
all other worship of gods is in vain, in vain, in vain. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
If the Guru is met, he makes the habit of repeating the Name firm;
ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ; ਨ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
if the Guru is met, the mind no longer runs in ten directions;
if the Guru is met, one stays clear of the five vices;
if the Guru is met, one does not waste away in grieving worry. ॥2॥
If the Guru is met, a person's speech becomes sweet;
if the Guru is met, he begins to speak of the indescribable Lord;
if the Guru is met, the body stays pure,
for if the Guru is met, one keeps repeating the Name. ॥3॥
If the Guru is met, a person sees that God is present in all three worlds;
if the Guru is met, he comes to know the high spiritual state;
if the Guru is met, the mind stays fixed at the Lord's feet;
if the Guru is met, one is always honoured everywhere. ॥4॥
If the Guru is met, a person stays ever detached while living in the world;
if the Guru is met, he slanders no one;
1167: if the Guru is met, he loves good and bad alike.
It is by meeting the Guru that the good writ on the forehead comes to light. ॥5॥
If the Guru is met, the body does not waste away in vices;
if the Guru is met, the proud of high caste cannot press him down, as the temple turned round to Namdev;
if the Guru is met, God Himself comes to the aid of the poor, as Namdev's hut was built;
if the Guru is met, God Himself helps, as the bed was brought out of the river. ॥6॥
If the Guru is met, know that one has bathed at the sixty-eight pilgrim places;
if the Guru is met, count the body as marked with the discus signs;
if the Guru is met, know that the twelve Shiva lingams have been worshipped;
if the Guru is met, all poisons turn into sweet fruit for him. ॥7॥
If the Guru is met, the doubts of the heart are ended;
ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ; ਤ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ॥
if the Guru is met, one is freed from the messengers of death;
if the Guru is met, a person crosses the world-ocean;
ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ; ਤ. ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ ॥੮॥
if the Guru is met, he is saved from birth and death. ॥8॥
If the Guru is met, there is no need for the rites of the eighteen Smritis;
if the Guru is met, all vegetation is seen as a daily offering to the Lord.
Apart from the Guru there is no other place where the true way of life is found;
Namdev has left all other supports and taken refuge with the Guru. ॥9॥1॥2॥11॥
ਭੈਰਉ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Without seeing Him, no longing to meet Him arises,
and all that is seen will perish.
One who sings the Lord's praises and repeats His Name,
he alone is the true yogi, and he becomes free of desire. ॥1॥
When someone remembers the Lord, his mind is absorbed in Him;
ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸੈ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
when he touches the Lord, the philosopher's stone, his sense of mine and yours ends. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੋ ਮੁਨਿ; ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
He is the true sage, who wipes out the sense of mine and yours from his mind,
and stays merged in the Lord who pervades the three worlds and has no body of ten doors.
ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੁਭਾਉ; ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ॥
Everyone acts after the nature of his own mind,
but one who repeats the Name becomes one with the Creator and dwells where there is no fear. ॥2॥
All vegetation blossoms for the sake of fruit;
when the fruit comes, the flower falls away.
So the daily work of the world is for the sake of insight into the higher life,
and when that insight arises, attachment to worldly striving ends. ॥3॥
A wise woman churns curd for the sake of ghee;
so one absorbed in the Lord is free while doing the world's work, and always without craving.
Says Ravidas: this is the talk of the highest detachment;
ਰਿਦੈ ਰਾਮੁ; ਕੀ. ਨ ਜਪਸਿ ਅਭਾਗ ॥੪॥੧॥
O luckless one, the Lord is in your own heart; why do you not remember Him? ॥4॥1॥
Come, O Kalandar Lord, O Lord of beautiful hair,
You have come in the garb of an Abdali fakir; welcome. ॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਆਕਾਸ, ਕੁਲਹ ਸਿਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ; ਕਉਸੈ ਸਪਤ ਪਯਾਲਾ ॥
You who have set the skies on Your head as a cap and made the seven underworlds Your sandals,
ਚਮਰ ਪੋਸ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਨੇ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
all living beings are Your dwelling; O Protector of the earth, this is how You are made. ॥1॥
ਛਪਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਾ ਪੇਹਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਸੋਲਹ ਸਹਸ ਇਜਾਰਾ ॥
Fifty-six crores of clouds are Your robe, and sixteen thousand worlds Your trousers;
ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ. ਮੁਦਗਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਸਹਨਕ ਸਭ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
all vegetation is Your staff, and the whole world Your earthen dish. ॥2॥
ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਜਿਦਿ, ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਾਨਾ; ਸਹਜ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰੈ ॥
My body is the mosque, my mind the mullah, offering the prayer of stillness;
ਬੀਬੀ ਕਉਲਾ ਸਉ. ਕਾਇਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
O Formless Lord of the whole world, You are wedded to Lady Lakshmi. ॥3॥
ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਤ. ਮੇਰੇ ਤਾਲ ਛਿਨਾਏ; ਕਿਹ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
While I was worshipping, You had me driven from the temple; to whom else can I open my heart?
ਨਾਮੇ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ; ਫਿਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬੇਦੇਸਵਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
Namdev's Master knows every heart and pervades all lands. ॥4॥1॥
1168: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ॥
Basant · Chaupade Dutuke · Guru Nanak · Ghar 1
ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
One Creator, whose Name is Truth: the Maker, all-pervading, without fear, without enmity, beyond time, unborn, self-existent — realised by the Guru's grace.
ਮਾਹਾ ਮਾਹ ਮੁਮਾਰਖੀ; ਚੜਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਬਸੰਤੁ ॥
Forget pride, and great rejoicings fill you, for the ever-blooming Lord becomes manifest within.
ਪਰਫੜੁ ਚਿਤ, ਸਮਾਲਿ ਸੋਇ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ॥੧॥
O my mind, keep the Lord who cares for creation always within you, and bloom. ॥1॥
O foolish mind, forget your self-centred outlook.
ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ. ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮਨ; ਗੁਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਲੈ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O mind, come to your senses and kill self-centredness; hold within you this highest virtue. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਰਮ ਪੇਡੁ. ਸਾਖਾ ਹਰੀ; ਧਰਮੁ ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Let daily deeds be the tree, the Lord's Name its branches, righteous living its flower and knowledge of God its fruit;
ਪਤ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ. ਛਾਵ ਘਣੀ; ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
attaining God are its leaves, humility its dense shade, and the mind's pride is gone. ॥2॥
ਅਖੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ. ਕੰਨੀ ਬਾਣੀ; ਮੁਖਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Such a one sees God in creation with his eyes, hears His praise with his ears, and speaks the everlasting Name;
ਪਤਿ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਆ; ਲਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੩॥
he gains the full wealth of honour, and his attention rests in stillness. ॥3॥
ਮਾਹਾ ਰੁਤੀ ਆਵਣਾ; ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
The world's months and seasons keep coming and going; do these deeds and see.
ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰੇ. ਨ ਸੂਕਹੀ; ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
O Nanak, those who stay absorbed in the Lord by the Guru's way stay green and never wither. ॥4॥1॥
O Lord, for them the season has come, and in this spring they remain in bloom,
ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਵਹਿ; ਸਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਾਇ ॥
those who are dyed in Your love and remember You live in the joy of meeting You.
Whom else should I worship with offerings? At whose feet else should I fall? ॥1॥
O radiant Lord, I remember You as the slave of Your slaves.
ਜਗਜੀਵਨ; ਜੁਗਤਿ. ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Life of the world, the way to meet You is found nowhere else. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
O Lord, Your being is one, Your forms are many.
Whom else should I worship with offerings? To whom else should I offer incense?
ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ; ਕਹਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
O Lord, the end of Your virtues cannot be found; how could anyone find it?
O radiant Lord, I remember You alone as the slave of Your slaves. ॥2॥
Your sixty years and all the pilgrim places,
for me are Your everlasting Name alone, O Supreme Lord.
What You are like cannot be understood or known;
without trying to understand it, one should repeat Your Name. ॥3॥
The whole world praises You, the One.
Nanak's head is at the feet of those who praise You.
ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਾਉ; ਜੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਵ ਹੈ ॥੪॥੨॥
I am a sacrifice to all the Names You have. ॥4॥2॥
If someone makes a cooking square of gold and uses vessels of gold,
draws lines of silver round it and spreads out many such works,
ਗੰਗਾ ਕਾ ਉਦਕੁ; ਕਰੰਤੇ ਕੀ ਆਗਿ ॥
brings Ganges water and a fire lit from arani wood,
and then eats rice cooked in milk, ॥1॥
ਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੇਖੈ; ਕਬਹੂ. ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
O mind, none of this show of purity is accepted
1169: ਜਾਮਿ. ਨ ਭੀਜੈ; ਸਾਚ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
so long as one is not soaked in the true Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
If a pandit keeps the eighteen Puranas written out beside him,
recites all four Vedas by heart,
bathes on holy days and gives alms to each caste as the Shastras prescribe,
and keeps fasts and observances day and night, still none of it pleases the Lord. ॥2॥
If some become qazis, mullahs and sheikhs,
some become yogis and jangams in saffron robes,
and some become householders, thorough in ritual,
each of them will be bound and driven on like a culprit, so long as he does not understand. ॥3॥
On the head of every being this command is written,
that each one's success will be judged by his deeds.
Those who take pride in rituals and garb are great fools.
O Nanak, the treasures of the everlasting Lord's praise are full. ॥4॥3॥
If someone strips off his clothes and becomes a naked ascetic, it is in vain;
by wearing matted hair no union with God is won.
Even by raising the breath to the tenth door, the mind does not become pure;
ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਵੈ; ਮੂੜੑਾ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
the fool wanders and wanders and is born again and again. ॥1॥
O foolish mind, meditate on the One;
ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ; ਇਕ ਖਿਨਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
you will cross over in a single moment. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Pandits expound the Smritis and Shastras to others;
yogis blow their horns, pandits read the Vedas, and some read the Puranas;
but their gaze is hypocritical, and in their minds they practise deceit;
the Lord does not come near such people. ॥2॥
If someone strives to master his senses,
performs special rites and worships the gods,
but greed is within him and his mind is caught in love of Maya,
how can such people attain the Lord untouched by Maya? ॥3॥
All is done by the Lord; nothing comes of what a being does.
Each one takes the path on which the Lord Himself sets him.
When the Lord looks with grace, He removes one's wandering;
when one understands His command, one attains union with the everlasting Lord. ॥4॥
One whose inner soul is soiled with vices,
even if he visits pilgrim places and roams other lands, his bonds do not break.
O Nanak, God is met only when the true Guru's company is found,
and only then are the bonds of the world-ocean broken. ॥5॥4॥
O Lord, through all the worlds is spread attachment to Your Maya.
ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਦੀਸੈ; ਸਰਬ ਤੋਹ ॥
I see no other than You; Your light is in all beings.
You are God even of the gods and the masters.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
O Lord, Your Name is found only by serving the Guru's feet. ॥1॥
O my beautiful Beloved, deep and large-hearted Lord,
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ; ਤੂ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Sustainer of all, You are infinite; one who turns to the Guru sings Your praises. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧ; ਨ ਪਾਈਐ. ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
Without the Guru the company of the Lord is not attained,
for without the Guru a person's body stays soiled with the filth of vices.
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ; ਨ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Without remembering the Lord's Name it cannot become pure.
One who praises the Lord through the Guru's word becomes one with the everlasting Lord. ॥2॥
O Protector Lord, the one You save from vices,
whom You bring to the true Guru and care for,
casts out the poison of pride and possessiveness;
O sovereign Lord, by Your grace all his sorrows are destroyed. ॥3॥
ਊਤਮ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
One in whom the Lord's virtues dwell rises to a high spiritual state and becomes large-hearted;
by the Guru's teaching the diamond of the Lord's Name shines within him;
ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਨਾਮਿ; ਤਜਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
leaving love of Maya, his attention is fixed on the Name.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ, ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੪॥੫॥
O Lord, unite servant Nanak with the Guru; bring about the meeting with the Guru. ॥4॥5॥
O my friends and companions, listen with love:
she with whom my beautiful Husband-Lord stays is the blessed wife.
ਓਹੁ ਅਲਖੁ. ਨ ਲਖੀਐ; ਕਹਹੁ ਕਾਇ ॥
He is beyond description and cannot be described; tell me, friends, how then is He met?
1170: She to whom the Guru has shown the radiant Lord at her side has met Him. ॥1॥
ਮਿਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਬਨੇ ॥
O friends and companions, sit together and sing; only the Lord's praises befit this human life.
ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਖੇਲਹਿ ਵਰ ਕਾਮਨਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਤ ਮਨ ਮਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The brides who play with the Lord God, seeking Him through the Guru, find their minds won over. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The luckless brides who follow their own minds do not grasp this secret,
ਓਹੁ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਵੈ; ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰੇਉ ॥
that the Beloved of all dwells within every body.
The bride who turns to the Guru sees the eternal radiant Lord at her side.
The Guru has made the Name firm in her heart, and she repeats that Name. ॥2॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ; ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
Without the Guru there is neither love for God nor devotion to Him.
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ; ਸੰਤ. ਨ ਸੰਗੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
Without the saintly Guru He does not grant His company.
Without the Guru, one blinded by Maya is gripped by worldly tangles and always weeps in sorrow.
ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਮਲੁ. ਸਬਦਿ ਖੋਇ ॥੩॥
But one who turns to the Guru destroys the mind's filth through the word and makes the mind pure. ॥3॥
One whose mind the Guru has killed by bringing about union with God
enjoys day and night the union of devotion to the Lord.
ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ; ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
In the gathering of the saintly Guru, sorrow is wiped out and disease removed,
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਸਹਜ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੪॥੬॥
for, O servant Nanak, such a one finds the Husband-Lord and the union of stillness. ॥4॥6॥
The Lord Himself fashions and makes His creation,
and, running His rule, the everlasting Lord Himself judges the deeds of beings.
Those given the Guru's excellent teaching see Him always at their side;
the finest savour of the Name comes to them as they rest in stillness. ॥1॥
ਮਤ ਬਿਸਰਸਿ; ਰੇ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਬੋਲਿ ॥
Do not forget Him, O mind; speak the Lord's Name.
ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਤੁਲਾਏ. ਅਤੁਲੁ ਤੋਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He is beyond the beyond, unreachable, beyond the senses and immeasurable; yet in those who turn to the Guru the Lord Himself weighs out His praise. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
O Lord, the Guru's Sikhs who serve the Guru's feet become Yours.
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਤਰੇ; ਤਜਿ ਮੇਰ ਤੋਰ ॥
Through serving the Guru they give up mine and yours and cross over.
But those who slander others, are greedy and hard of heart,
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ. ਨ ਭਾਈ; ਸਿ ਚੋਰ ਚੋਰ ॥੨॥
who do not like the service the Guru teaches, are thieves of thieves. ॥2॥
Those with whom the Guru is pleased he blesses with devotion and love for the Lord.
ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ; ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਠਾਉ ॥
When the Guru is pleased, a place is found at the Lord's door.
Giving up slander of others, they become watchful in devotion to the Lord.
By His grace the lovely devotion to the Lord becomes their share. ॥3॥
Those whom the Guru unites with the congregation and gives the gift of the Name,
those dear Sikhs of the Guru keep it day and night.
ਫਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ; ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਸਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
The Name, the true aim of human life, is received by those to whom the Guru gives it in his pleasure;
Says Nanak: only a rare few attain it. ॥4॥7॥
Only if it pleases the Master can a servant serve Him;
such a servant stays detached from Maya while living in the world, and saves all his family too. ॥1॥
ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ. ਨ ਛੋਡਉ; ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਹਸੈ ॥
O Lord, I will not give up devotion to You; what do I care if anyone laughs?
ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਮੇਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
May Your everlasting Name dwell in my heart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ; ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗਲਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
As a person stays sunk in attachment to Maya,
ਤੈਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਵਤ ਰਹੈ ॥੨॥
so the saint keeps remembering the Lord's Name. ॥2॥
ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਊਪਰਿ; ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ॥
O Lord, have mercy on me, foolish and ignorant,
that I may stay in Your refuge. ॥3॥
ਕਹਤੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੇ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
Says Nanak: the works of the world all prove fruitless;
ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੮॥
by the Guru's grace a rare one attains the Name that gives spiritual life. ॥4॥8॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਸਾਲ ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਬਿਪ ਪੂਜਿ ਮਨਾਵਹੁ; ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤੁਲਸੀ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
O Brahmin, worship the merciful Lord and win His favour, that is the saligram; good conduct is the tulsi rosary.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਬੇੜਾ ਬਾਂਧਹੁ; ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੧॥
Build the boat by repeating the Lord's Name, and pray: O merciful Lord, have mercy. ॥1॥
